# Godot Demo Projects Test Fixtures

The test fixtures in this directory are sourced from the [Godot Demo Projects](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects) repository.

## Files

- `tileset.tres` - From `2d/hexagonal_map/tileset.tres` - A TileSet resource with hexagonal tile configuration
- `player.tscn` - From `2d/dodge_the_creeps/player.tscn` - A player scene with animations and particle effects
- `theme.tres` - From `2d/platformer/gui/theme.tres` - A UI theme resource with button styles
- `ball.tscn` - From `2d/instancing/ball.tscn` - A simple physics-enabled ball scene

These fixtures are used to test the parser against real-world Godot resource files.
